europe_now.title: EU’s Kallas labels Leipzig drone attack ‘state-sponsored terrorism’
europe_now.summary: Kaja Kallas labeled the Leipzig drone attack as state‑sponsored terrorism. The designation frames the incident as a hostile act by a foreign state.
